conceptZh: 拉布拉多警長先衝過頭打滑，第二次全力助跑一頭撞上被大怪獸笨拙碰關的厚重鐵門，撞飛的鐵條鐵板在空中落下拼成「鐵」字，自己則扁扁暈眩笑著敬禮。
object: heavy riveted iron door and loose iron bars
morph: iron door bars, plates, rivets, and curved latch blasted loose by the crash drop into place to form 鐵
creativeAngle: 捨棄原構想靜態的鐵鏟介紹，改以拉布拉多警長對厚重鐵門的「衝刺撞扁」肢體喜劇為主軸，搭配大怪獸笨拙碰關門與結尾開合小鐵門的聲畫呼應，讓「鐵門」詞彙自然融入笑點並完整保留超過三秒的清晰定格。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright stylized 3D cartoon animation in an uncluttered warm pale-cream yard under soft daylight, with clean saturated colors and no white blowouts or dark grading. Cast: a big friendly cartoon golden Labrador sheriff dog with a shiny star badge and dangling silver whistle, and a huge round fuzzy teal one-horned cartoon monster with a goofy grin.

0.0–1.5s: On the left, the Labrador sheriff spots a towering, riveted steel-blue iron door on the right. Behind it, the clumsy one-horned monster turns around cheerfully and accidentally hip-bumps the heavy door slammed shut with a goofy grin. The sheriff digs his paws in and leans way back in a big wind-up.

1.5–3.2s: The sheriff blasts forward—and skids straight past the iron door in a wild cartoon slide! Scrambling back to the left, he digs in deeper, leans even farther back with spinning paws, and rockets dead-center at the iron door.

3.2–4.8s: After a split-second freeze of anticipation, the sheriff smashes into the iron door with a huge squashy cartoon BONK! Flattened like a goofy pancake, he bounces back as the crash blasts the door's iron bars, rivets, plates, and curved latch skyward. The loose metal pieces drop to center frame and lock into the exact standard Traditional Chinese character 「鐵」 in bold, solid saturated deep iron-indigo against the pale-cream backdrop.

4.8–8.0s: For over 3 full seconds, the finished Traditional Chinese glyph 「鐵」 holds motionless, centered, uncropped, and crisp at about 70% of frame height with wide margins; only this single glyph appears as text, with no subtitles or watermarks. Below and clear of the strokes, the flattened sheriff peels up, wobbles with dizzy eyes and a goofy grin, and gives a proud paw salute. At the lower right, clear of the glyph, the fuzzy monster swings open a compact riveted cartoon iron door on cue, then clumsily hip-bumps it softly shut as both grin.

Audio: A warm, friendly off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin voice speaks ONLY: "鐵、鐵、鐵門 (ㄊㄧㄝˇ、ㄊㄧㄝˇ、ㄊㄧㄝˇ ㄇㄣˊ)", pronouncing each syllable slowly and distinctly with clear Taiwan standard tones, then stops. Speak the first "鐵" at 3.3s as the crash sends iron pieces flying, the second "鐵" at 4.5s as the strokes lock into 「鐵」, and "鐵門" at 5.6s right as the monster swings open the cartoon iron door. Harmless cartoon bonk and soft metallic clink stay quieter than the voice.

conceptZh: 馬達太衝的拼裝玩具機器人滿場追逐偷載厚重鐵板與鐵條的大眼迴力賽車，過彎打滑摔跤後飛撲肚皮著地撞飛零件排成「鐵」字，最後開心舉起鐵板又讓賽車鼻頭輕撞彈開。
object: heavy riveted dark-iron plate, loose iron bars, and metal rivets
morph: the flying belly-flop crash into the overshooting toy race car blasts loose iron bars, rivets, and dark metal skid trails upward to lock cleanly into 鐵
creativeAngle: 以完全原創的拼裝玩具機器人與大眼迴力賽車取代前版易觸發第三方版權疑慮的警長狗與毛怪；從衝撞鐵門改為越追越大圈、打滑摔跤再飛撲肚皮撞擊的追逐喜劇，並改用「鐵板」一詞，在定格結尾讓賽車再度暴衝輕撞機器人舉起的厚重鐵板，音畫緊密呼應且遠離版權風險。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright stylized 3D toy-craft cartoon animation on an uncluttered warm pale-cream tabletop under soft daylight, with saturated colors and no glare or dark grading. Cast: an original mismatched boxy toy robot (square sky-blue tin body, button eyes, tiny left arm, extra-long springy brass right arm, clunky iron boots, over-strong motors) and a chunky mint-green pull-back toy race car with wobbly craft googly eyes glued on its front bumper.

0.0–1.5s: On the left, the robot spots a heavy riveted dark-iron plate topped with iron bars at center-right. Squeaking, the mint-green race car zips in, scoops the plate and bars onto its roof, and peels out as the robot's eyes pop wide and its over-strong boots spin in place.

1.5–3.2s: The tiny car zips in swift loops while the robot chases in bigger and bigger loops. Its over-revving motors whip it wide round a corner—its long springy arm flails, its boots skid sideways, and it trips over its own feet in a silly tumble before scrambling up for an all-out sprint.

3.2–4.8s: As the car overshoots a turn at center, the robot leaps high, holds a split-second mid-air freeze, and lands in a squashy belly-flop right behind it! With a bouncy BONK, the car rams nose-first into the iron plate; loose iron bars, rivets, and dark metal skid trails burst upward and lock cleanly into the exact standard Traditional Chinese character 「鐵」 in bold, solid dark iron-indigo at dead center.

4.8–8.0s: For over 3 full seconds, 「鐵」 holds motionless, centered, uncropped, and crisp at 70% of frame height with wide margins; only this single glyph appears as text, with no subtitles or watermarks. Below and clear of the strokes, the dazed robot wobbles up grinning, holding up the thick riveted iron plate with its long springy arm as the squeaky car zips back, overshoots, and gently boops nose-first into the plate, bouncing back with rattling googly eyes.

Audio: A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks in clear Taiwanese Mandarin ONLY: "鐵、鐵、鐵板 (ㄊㄧㄝˇ、ㄊㄧㄝˇ、ㄊㄧㄝˇ ㄅㄢˇ)", reading those exact syllables slowly and distinctly with Taiwan standard tones, then stops. Speak the first "鐵" at 3.4s as the crash scatters iron pieces, the second "鐵" at 4.6s as the strokes lock into 「鐵」, and "鐵板" at 5.6s as the robot lifts the iron plate and the car boops it. Soft whirring, squeaks, gentle bonk, and metallic clink stay quieter than the voice.
